about_the_game:
Echoes of the Core is a third-person platformer that takes you deep inside the planet. Step into the shoes of the Traveler, a young man born under the rule of the Brotherhood of the Eternal Core, a secret society that for generations has protected the hidden power that once transformed entire civilizations.

Your mission is to complete the Trial — a descent into the planet’s deepest layers — and prove yourself worthy of obtaining the hidden power before the Brotherhood. However, this will be far from easy: on your journey, you'll face countless challenges and trials that will determine whether you are truly fit to wield this immense power.

As you venture deeper into the abyss, the Traveler will discover what happened to the ancient civilizations and why they vanished without a trace.

The truth lies deep within the Earth’s core, where ancient civilizations forged their empires far from the surface. Your destiny is written—face the adversities and become the hero of the prophecy.

Key Features:

  • Singleplayer or Multiplayer: Uncover the secrets of the planet on your own or with up to 3 allies. Learn to harness the physics of the energy beam to cooperatively overcome every level.

  • Energy Management: Manage the exoskeleton’s energy according to the situation to advance quickly. If the counter reaches 0, it’s game over.

  • Lore: Discover the lost secrets of past civilizations by collecting the forbidden artifacts.

  • Biomes and Civilizations: Journey into the planet’s interior and behold the variety of biomes and civilizations that form a rich and diverse world.

  • Elemental Traps: Dare to confront countless traps that exploit elements like water and lava, obstacles that will try to stop you from reaching your goal. You won’t be able to stop playing until you conquer them!

  • Unreal Engine 5: Experience environments with an overwhelming level of detail and realism, thanks to the technical prowess of the engine. The game features numerous elements that depict ancient civilizations in a way never seen before.

  • Many Deaths

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64 bits
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400/AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 50 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: SSD is recommended. Online connection is required for multiplayer features

short_description: Echoes of the Core is a third person platformer set in the depths of the planet. Explore ancient forgotten civilizations, overcome levels filled with elemental traps, and uncover the secrets buried in the very core of the Earth. The echo of the past is calling... Will you answer?
